summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the redesigned User Dashboard. All features working correctly: dynamic greeting with real API data, 4 stat cards with live numbers, 8 quick action buttons with correct navigation, workspace cards with real data, Usage & Limits section, Upcoming Meetings, Recent Transcriptions, and Security card. Mobile responsive at 375px with no horizontal scroll.
passed_tests: Dashboard page loads at /dashboard after login with admin@munal.com / Admin@123456
Hero section shows dynamic greeting (Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening) based on time of day
Hero section displays user name 'Admin' with gradient styling
Hero section shows workspace count (6 workspaces) from real API data
Hero section shows team member count (10 team members) from real API data
Hero section shows pending approvals count (7 pending approvals) from real API data
Stats grid shows 4 stat cards: Workspaces (6), Team Members (10), Approvals (7), Announcements (5)
Stats cards have correct data-testid='dashboard-stats'
Quick Actions section has data-testid='dashboard-quick-actions'
Quick action 'New Meeting' button navigates to /meetings
Quick action 'Record' button navigates to /quick-record
Quick action 'Transcribe' button navigates to /transcriptions
Quick action 'Chat' button navigates to /workspace/chat
Quick action 'Workspaces' button navigates to /workspaces
Quick action 'eSignature' button navigates to /e-signature
Quick action 'AI Assistant' button navigates to /ai-chat
Quick action 'Reports' button navigates to /reports
All 8 quick action buttons have correct data-testid attributes
Workspace cards section shows real workspace data with names (Anatomy & physiology I, HR Department Hub, TEST_Marketing_948230, My First Workspace)
Workspace cards show member counts and scope badges (Team/Org)
Clicking workspace card navigates to /workspace/{id}
Usage & Limits section renders with data-testid='usage-dashboard'
Usage Dashboard shows current plan (Free) and usage metrics
Upcoming Meetings section renders with 'No meetings scheduled' empty state
Recent Transcriptions section renders with 'No transcriptions yet' empty state
Security card renders with data-testid='security-card'
Security card has Password link with data-testid='security-password-link'
Security card has 2FA link with data-testid='security-2fa-link'
Dashboard is mobile responsive at 375px viewport width
No horizontal scroll on mobile (375px)
Hero section fits within mobile viewport (311px width)
Stats grid displays in 2-column layout on mobile
Quick Actions display in 2-column grid on mobile
No console errors on dashboard page
